36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
126824: Maomao works as an apothecary in the red light district, helping her mentor and father Luomen in caring for its residents, with special attention given to the Verdigris Hall brothel, where she was born and was initially raised.
127278: Jinshi is the eunuch in charge of the affairs of the inner palace. He is described as having a face capable even of outshining the consorts in beauty, amazing women and men alike.
144110: The current Emperor fulfills the role expected of him. He is hated by his mother, the Empress dowager, for being the product of her rape. His most trustworthy relationship is with his brother, who manages small things behind the scenes for him.
156764: The Virtuous consort, residing in the Diamond Palace within the inner court. She was sent to be a high consort on the inner court as a young child because her prominent family was aware of the previous Emperor's pedophilic tendencies.
156765: The Pure consort, residing in the Garner Palace within the inner court. She was the current Emperor's milk sibling and childhood crush, being just a year older than him. She became the previous Emperor's consort and gave birth to his child at 18, who was stillborn.
156766: The Able consort, residing in the Crystal Palace within the inner court. The second most favoured consort of the Emperor, said to be so in big part due to her voluptuous chest.
156767: The Noble consort, residing in the Jade Palace within the inner court. Her red hair and green eyes distinguish her from the other consorts, that being part of the reasons she became the Emperor's favoured consort, having already given birth to a girl of his.
232926: Lakan is a renowned strategist known for his nonchalant disregard of proper manners. His plotting ability causes fear even in the Emperor himself. He sees people's faces as a piece of shogi representing their worth, with a few exceptions like the woman he loved and his daughter.
244317: Gaoshun is Jinshi's attendant. He's shown to be extremely dependable. A stern believer in deference to authority and proper etiquette, his disapproval is often splattered in his transparent facial expressions, even if he says nothing.
244319: Meimei is one of the Three Princesses of Verdigris Hall. She started as Fenshen's apprentice and, being somewhat cunning herself, inherited Fenshen's taste for strategy board games. She is the most attached to the brothel and the people within.
244321: A mid-rank consort, princess of a distant land. She became the Emperor's middle consort against her will.
244995: The (new) Pure consort, residing in the Garnet Palace within the inner court. She makes a big show of her exorbitant and ever changing clothing, jewellery and make up. Despite that, she doesn't talk any more than she needs to, keeping her distance.
244996: Lingli is the baby of high consort Gyokuyou. She's the first child of the current Emperor to survive. She's nicknamed Xiaoling by her mother, meaning Little Bell.
261968: Ruomen is a physician of the Inner Court, a physician in the red-light district, and Maomao's father.
274186: Xiaolan is a servant in the inner court of the palace. Carefree and easy to please, she looks at her sale to the inner palace as a good thing, since at least she now has proper bedding and meals.
274187: Once a high ranking courtesan herself, the Madam is now the runner of the Vergidris Hall.
274188: Anshi, the Empress Dowager, is the wife of the previous Emperor, mother to the current one. She joined the inner court at 10 years of age as the attendant to a consort and unwillingly got the previous Emperor's attention with her childish innocence.
274189: Pairin is the oldest of the Three Princesses of Verdigris Hall. She loves men's bodies and dreams of being taken away by a muscular prince.
274191: Fenshen used to be a high ranking courtesan in Verdigris Hall. With a flinty and hard personality, she was unmatched at strategy board games. She fell in love with a man who could challenge her at those, but was later abandoned after bedding him.
274192: Guen is the current physician of the inner court. The requirement of being castrated to be allowed to work inside the inner court does not attract many physicians to choose from.
274193: Joka is the youngest of the Three Princesses of Verdigris Hall and one of Maomao's adopted sisters.
274194: Suirei is a court lady, doing menial tasks in the outer court.
274195: Lihaku is a military officer, residing in the outer court of the palace. He's strong and honest, but not exactly brilliant.
274196: Shishou is the current prime-minister and head of the Shi clan. His cunning transformed him from essentially no one of importance to one of the most influential men in the nation.
318472: The head lady-in-waiting of the Crystal Pavillion.
323687: Subordinate of Lakan. A very capable official, he is gentle, diligent, and quick-witted.
354824: Ayla is a special envoy from a foreign nation along with her sister Aylin
354825: Aylin is a special envoy from a foreign country along with her twin sister Ayla
364109: Lahan is the adopted son of Lakan and a number loving eccentric.
365246: Shenmei is the daughter of the former Shi Clan head, main wife of Prime Minister and current Shi clan head Shishou, and mother to Consort Loulan.
